transcript:
Bot: Namaste, Osho Industries se baat ho rahi hai?
Seller: Haan ji, kaun?
Bot: IndiaMART se bol rahi hoon. Aapke products ke liye buyers BuyLeads post kar rahe hain.
Seller: BuyLeads? Yeh kya hota hai beta?
Bot: BuyLeads matlab verified buyer requirements with order size and demand value, aap Lead Manager se access kar sakte hain.
Seller: Samajh nahi aaya. Angrezi mein mat bolo.
Bot: Ji. BuyLeads verified requirements hote hain, Lead Manager mein dikhte hain, aap contact kar sakte hain.
Seller: Beta mujhe samajh nahi aa raha. Mere bete se baat kar lo kal.
Bot: Sir BuyLeads se aapko direct buyers milte hain, TrustSEAL plan mein 21 weekly...
Seller: Rakhta hoon.
